a) Statement of compliance
The financial statements have been prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
For the Kenyan Companies Act reporting purposes, in these financial statements the balance sheet is represented by/equivalent
to the statement of financial position and the profit and loss account is presented in the statement of comprehensive
income.
